The actions shown include adding a user, resetting a password, and viewing role settings, which are ordinary administrative training tasks. Although the description promotes IT courses and premium or live training, it does not show deceptive payment mechanics, guaranteed employment, or victim-loss outcomes.

opening.argument: Judge, consider the promise alongside the requested action. The description says viewers can learn IT in three to six months and be doing the tasks employers will ask of them. It then directs them to become premium members or take live training. The narration also tells new viewers to register before accessing the free course. The Office 365 lesson gives the offer credibility, but the practical question is whether its demonstrated tasks substantiate that broader, accelerated career-readiness promise. On this record, they do not.
